changeSet.author: datarun
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON SCHEMA feed IS 'The submission feed, contract version 1 (docs/features/submission-feed/contract.md): current state for downstream analytics. Written only by the feed publisher.'
COMMENT ON SCHEMA feed_ops IS 'The submission feed publisher''s bookkeeping. Never granted, never part of the analytics copy.'
CREATE SEQUENCE feed.position_seq AS bigint START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1 NO CYCLE CACHE 1
COMMENT ON SEQUENCE feed.position_seq IS 'The feed''s position, shared by submission and submission_row; CACHE 1, taken under the publisher''s lock in commit order.'

CREATE TABLE feed.submission ( position bigint NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, entered_start_at timestamptz, entered_end_at timestamptz, changed_at timestamptz NOT NULL, published_at timestamptz NOT NULL, deleted boolean NOT NULL, id text NOT NULL, form_id text NOT NULL, form_version_id text, assignment_id text NOT NULL, team_id text NOT NULL, org_unit_id text NOT NULL, activity_id text NOT NULL, field_values jsonb NOT NULL, unmapped_values jsonb, CONSTRAINT pk_feed_submission PRIMARY KEY (id) ) WITH (fillfactor = 80)
CREATE INDEX idx_feed_submission_position ON feed.submission USING brin (position) WITH (pages_per_range = 4, autosummarize = on)
COMMENT ON TABLE feed.submission IS 'Stream submission: one record per submission, live or deleted; key id, cursor field position.'

CREATE TABLE feed.submission_row ( position bigint NOT NULL, changed_in_version bigint NOT NULL, published_at timestamptz NOT NULL, row_index integer NOT NULL, deleted boolean NOT NULL, submission_id text NOT NULL, id text NOT NULL, id_origin text NOT NULL, parent_row_id text, section_id text NOT NULL, field_values jsonb NOT NULL, unmapped_values jsonb, CONSTRAINT pk_feed_submission_row PRIMARY KEY (submission_id, id) ) WITH (fillfactor = 80)
CREATE INDEX idx_feed_submission_row_position ON feed.submission_row USING brin (position) WITH (pages_per_range = 4, autosummarize = on)
COMMENT ON TABLE feed.submission_row IS 'Stream submission_row: one record per row ever published in a submission''s current record; key (submission_id, id), cursor field position.'

CREATE TABLE feed.form_field ( form_id text NOT NULL, form_version_id text NOT NULL, form_version_number integer NOT NULL, field_id text NOT NULL, section_id text, repeat_section_id text, name text NOT NULL, label jsonb, value_type text, option_set_id text, mandatory boolean, sort_order integer, published_at timestamptz NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_feed_form_field UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (form_version_id, section_id, field_id) )
COMMENT ON TABLE feed.form_field IS 'Stream form_field (the dictionary): one record per field placement per form version; unique (form_version_id, section_id, field_id), nulls not distinct.'

CREATE TABLE feed.form_section ( form_id text NOT NULL, form_version_id text NOT NULL, form_version_number integer NOT NULL, section_id text NOT NULL, parent_section_id text, name text, label jsonb, repeatable boolean NOT NULL, sort_order integer, published_at timestamptz NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_feed_form_section PRIMARY KEY (form_version_id, section_id) )
COMMENT ON TABLE feed.form_section IS 'Stream form_section (the dictionary): one record per section per form version; key (form_version_id, section_id).'

CREATE TABLE feed.freshness ( feed text NOT NULL, last_position bigint, last_published_at timestamptz, last_changed_at timestamptz, backlog bigint NOT NULL, oldest_unpublished_at timestamptz, pending bigint NOT NULL, oldest_pending_at timestamptz, dead bigint NOT NULL, unpublished bigint, last_reconciled_at timestamptz, first_publication_completed_at timestamptz, checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_feed_freshness PRIMARY KEY (feed) )
COMMENT ON TABLE feed.freshness IS 'Stream freshness: how far each feed has got and what waits; one record per feed, key feed (submissions).'
